en: Angel... The heroes fought valiantly, but... the capital of the Holy Nation of Ecclesia has fallen to the Empire.{wait}{clear}The city was destroyed, and the cathedral was set ablaze.{wait}{clear}Many people perished, but it seems some managed to escape.{wait}{clear}Angel, I am deeply worried about what will become of Arcaya... Please take great care as well, Angel.

Angel! A hero has defeated Clarence, the one called Viper, who stole the Demon Stone from the Holy Nation of Ecclesia.{wait}{clear}It appears he could hold no hope for this world, and sided with the Empire of his own accord...

Angel! The devil that possessed Endymion has shown itself, along with the castle of the legendary Crimson Moon King!{wait}{clear}Unless that devil and the Heavenly Dragon are defeated, peace will not return to Arcaya!{wait}{clear}Angel, I beg you, defeat the devil and the Heavenly Dragon together with the heroes, and save the world!

Angel! It seems a man named Fein Lu Lugus of Celesta in the Six Kingdoms Alliance was well suited to be a hero candidate...{wait}{clear}But his life was taken by mysterious mages.{wait}{clear}It is most regrettable, but one of Arcaya's hopes has been lost.

It is most regrettable, but one of Arcaya's hopes has been lost.
